description: Restyle all host components (RequestQueue, RequestViews, MenuManager, InventoryManager, LocationManager, AudioAlert, FridgeScan, QRPrintView, ReviewDraftModal) to follow the One Filled Thing style guide. The key rule: NEW requests get the Live fill block (bg-[#A8512C] with white text), everything else is ruled rows with ink and space. No emoji, no rounded corners, no shadows, no colored badges, no tinted panels.
steps: Restyle src/components/host/RequestQueue.tsx: Remove CATEGORY_ICONS emoji map entirely. Category tile grid becomes a list of ruled rows (1px rule border-bottom separating each category heading with its count in mono). Remove rounded-xl, bg-white border-2, shadow-sm, dashed borders. Request rows with status NEW get the Live block treatment: full-width solid bg-live (#A8512C) fill with white text (this is THE one filled thing). SEEN requests are plain ruled rows. DONE requests show ink-35 text with line-through. Action buttons: 'Seen' is secondary (1px ink outline, 48px), 'Done' is primary (1.5px live outline, 48px). Remove bg-blue-50, bg-yellow-500, bg-green-500 button fills. Count badges become plain mono numerals, no colored pill backgrounds. The expand/collapse toggle uses ink text, no animated rotation.

Restyle src/components/host/RequestViews.tsx: Remove group-by tab bar with rounded-xl/bg-blue-600 active state. Replace with ruled underline tabs (current tab has 1.5px ink underline). Remove STATUS_COLORS map with colored badges. Status indicators become mono text at appropriate ink opacities (NEW at 100%, SEEN at 72%, DONE at 35%). Filter selects use underline style (no box, no rounded-lg). Group containers: remove rounded-xl border-2 bg-white. Use ruled rows with 1px rule separators. Expand/collapse uses ink arrow. Remove all emoji from category display. Counts in mono font.

Restyle src/components/host/MenuManager.tsx: Remove rounded-xl from inputs and item containers. Input fields use border-bottom only (underline style, 1px rule). Add buttons are primary style (1.5px live outline, 48px, live text). Toggle switches: replace green/gray rounded-full with a simple ruled checkbox or a 6px state dot (live color when on, rule color when off). Delete button is tertiary (underlined x). Section headings in mono caps. Item list uses ruled rows (1px border-bottom), no card container.

Restyle src/components/host/InventoryManager.tsx: Remove rounded-xl, bg-white, border-2 containers. Remove colored status badges (bg-red-100/bg-yellow-100 pills). Status indicated by: out-of-stock items get ink-35 with line-through, low-stock items get 6px live dot beside them. Quantity displayed in mono. Edit inputs use underline style. Save button is primary (1.5px live outline), Cancel is tertiary (underlined word). Section layout is ruled rows with 1px separators.

Restyle src/components/host/LocationManager.tsx: Remove rounded-xl from input, button, and location cards. Input uses underline style. Add button is primary. Location items are ruled rows (1px border-bottom) with QR image, location name, and URL in mono at ink-50. Action buttons (Copy Link, Print QR) are tertiary (underlined words, 44px targets). Remove bg-gray-100 hover fills.

Restyle src/components/host/AudioAlert.tsx: Remove emoji (bell, mute icons). Remove bg-green-50, border-green-200, animate-pulse. Enabled state shows a 6px live dot with 'alerts on' in mono at ink-50. Disabled state is a tertiary button (underlined 'enable alerts', 44px target). Remove orange-colored border and text.

Restyle src/components/host/FridgeScan.tsx: Remove rounded-lg, bg-purple-600 scan button fill, emoji camera icon. Scan button is primary (1.5px live outline, live text). File input styled minimally. Error dismiss link is underlined word. Remove bg-gray-100 file input styling.
Restyle src/components/host/QRPrintView.tsx: Remove rounded from close button. Close button is secondary (1px ink outline, 48px). Print layout uses ink text, no gray color classes.

Restyle src/components/host/ReviewDraftModal.tsx: Remove rounded-xl, shadow-xl, bg-black/50 backdrop. Modal is full-width panel with 1px rule border, paper background. Remove rounded from inputs. Inputs use underline style. Publish button is primary (1.5px live outline, live text, 48px). Cancel is secondary (1px ink outline, 48px). Remove item X button coloring, use ink. Add another link is tertiary (underlined word).
acceptance_criteria: Zero emoji in any host component file
Zero instances of rounded-*, shadow-*, bg-blue-*, bg-green-*, bg-yellow-*, bg-red-*, bg-purple-* in host components
NEW request items render with bg-live (#A8512C) solid fill and white text (the one filled thing)
All other content uses only ink, rule, and paper colors
All interactive targets are at least 44px tall
Numbers and status strings use the mono font class
